estimated_cost_per_request: provider-reported 10-15 Easyparser credits per OFFER request (evidence: request-ledger of local prior run manifest-20260822T080742Z-9e71); code-documented planning estimate is 5 credits (enrichment_preflight.CREDIT_ESTIMATES['EASYPARSER'])
currency: provider price not locally verified; no USD figure asserted
pricing_source: local evidence only: prior local run request-ledger (reported credits/request) + enrichment_preflight documented estimate. No dashboard quote, no invoice, no provider pricing page captured locally.
credit_metadata_quality_note: Prior provider-reported credits (10,11,12,13,14,15) were not perfectly self-consistent with the credits_remaining series; treated as provider-reported metadata only, never assumed. Actual consumption is read from each live response at run time and recorded in the ledger.
worst_case_billing: 10 requests at the observed max 15 credits = 150 credits; hard credit cap 200 stops the run before exceeding it. If the provider reports higher per-request credits, the credit cap halts the run early (fewer requests, never more spend).
condition_to_run: operator's explicit LIVE NOW approval of the exact command in preflight/live-command-plan.md
